summary: Before describing how far the land has sunk in {place}, the planner checks the date on the survey map.
realLife: California ordered its water department to speed up updates to land subsidence data used in groundwater management.
gates: A subsidence survey has a footprint and measurement date.
inGame: needs: a subsidence survey has a footprint and measurement date.

turns.pulledBy: The new survey covers the area.
turns.what: Use the newer survey for the covered area.
turns.writesBack: Save its observation date with the map.

turns.pulledBy: The new survey lacks local coverage.
turns.what: Mark the area the new survey missed.
turns.writesBack: Retain the older observation date there.
